nurse.text: Come in, come in, shut the door, the wind's after us. This is the King Edward Point surgery. Everyone here is somebody's doctor, plumber and drinks waiter.
What can we do for you?

then.text: Sit by the radiator. Your team will be warm in a minute, which is more than I can say for the rest of the island.
All done, right as rain. And it has rained.
The Ark's through there, next to the freezer. Do mind the penguin biscuits.

else.text: No bother. Pop in any time. We're not going anywhere. There's nowhere to go.
